owner: KDE native-document transport/presentation adapter; existing common tail owner, managed-word readout and final verifier
first_failed_transitions: Same-field rich second-word fixture: VisibleTailV4 retains U+00A0 in the older separator, while DOM and production AT-SPI GetText both return U+0020 after typing the next word. Current-word text, caret, native peer and character geometry agree. Native hint eligibility wrongly demands full old-tail manual-edit agreement, suppressing rect and append despite the existing fresh managed-word witness.

Closed rich layout edit dispatches a target ending in ASCII Space. Production native GetText returns the same target with final NBSP. The existing raw full-snapshot result comparison correctly refuses that unacknowledged presentation; layout settlement and the following gesture/decoder stall. The common tail owner already supports acknowledging its newly emitted final Space as NBSP.
decision: Use native binding validity plus the existing exact_managed_surrounding_word_is_current contract for display/explicit append. Hint geometry may use this readout contract or the existing full-tail manual contract. Keep native_manual_word_is_current and all whole-word/correction permissions unchanged; never rewrite an older separator to manufacture agreement.

A small KDE native_document/client_presentation module recognizes only an already pending native LayoutProjection result, current owner/epoch/field and exact full field/caret/selection equality except its final newly emitted ASCII Space becoming NBSP. Reuse acknowledge_owned_space_tail to retain shared/local ownership state; update only that result's acknowledged presentation and run the unchanged canonical final verifier. Preserve original expiry, source, feedback and scope. No general Unicode/whitespace normalization or output fallback.

Repeat unchanged r18 and cold/same-field4 before broader Chrome qualification and user acceptance.
